worker.unavailable: No GPU worker in this build
pause.hardware_fault: Stopped after repeated worker failures (possible hardware fault)
pause.reject_everywhere: Shares rejected on every pool: update the miner
mgr.failing_over: failing over from pool {from} to pool {to}
launch.title: GPU worker launch
banner.wallet_changed: Your payout wallet was changed through {src} (was {prev}, now {now}). If you did not do this, stop mining and check your computer.
banner.sim: SIMULATION: the GPU worker is the CPU reference miner. It only finds shares on the test pool; nothing is mined on real pools.
banner.no_cuda: This build has no CUDA worker yet. Turn on the CPU simulation under Performance & Power to test the setup, or use spark-modo (external launch).
login.title: Log in
login.text: Run this on the miner to open the GUI already logged in (it passes a secret token that only your user can read):
login.token_hint: It is in ~/.config/spark-pearl-miner/api-token (readable only by you).
login.expired: Your session ended (the miner restarted?). Log in again.
wizard.intro: This setup takes about two minutes: your wallet, your worker name, up to three pools with automatic failover, the fee disclosure and the power profile. Choose your language:
wizard.pools.title: Pools (up to 3)
wizard.pools.intro: Pool 1 is used first. If it fails, the miner moves to pool 2, then pool 3, and returns to pool 1 by itself when it is healthy again. The defaults work; change them if you prefer other pools.
wallet.title: Your Pearl wallet
wallet.intro: Rewards are paid by the pools to this address. It must be a Pearl mainnet address that starts with prl1p.
wallet.label: Wallet address
wallet.hint: Tip: copy it from your wallet app. Exchange deposit addresses work, but check the exchange's minimum deposit against the pool's payout threshold.
wallet.err.mixed_case: Mixed upper and lower case is not allowed.
wallet.err.too_long: Too long for a Pearl address.
wallet.err.format: This does not look like a Pearl address (prl1p…).
wallet.err.charset: It contains a character that addresses never use (b, i, o or 1 after the prefix, or a symbol).
wallet.err.checksum: Checksum mismatch: a character is wrong or missing. Copy the address again.
wallet.err.hrp: This is not a Pearl address (it must start with prl1).
wallet.err.length: Wrong length for a prl1p… address.
worker.title: Worker name
worker.intro: Pools show your machine under this name. Letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters.
worker.label: Worker
pools.tls.auto: Auto (TLS, plain only if the pool has no TLS)
pools.pin_hint: LuckyPool uses a self-signed certificate; the miner checks this exact key instead.
pools.advanced_hint: Leave these on Auto unless the pool asks otherwise. Auto encoding learns the proof field the pool accepts and remembers it.
pools.name: Label
pools.test.confirm: The login test connects to this pool with your wallet and worker name and waits for a job. Nothing is mined or submitted. Continue?
pools.test.ok: Reachable. (DNS, TCP and TLS only; the login was not tested.)
pools.test.ok_auth: Reachable, login accepted and a job received.
pools.err.host: Enter a host name or IP address.
pools.err.pin: A pinned pool needs the 44-character base64 key.
pools.err.fix: Fix the highlighted pool settings first.
pools.edit_hint: Save & Apply reconnects only the pools you changed. Order is priority: pool 1 first.
err.dns_failed: The pool's name could not be resolved (DNS). Check the host name and your internet connection.
err.dns_timeout: DNS did not answer in time.
err.connect_refused: The pool refused the connection (wrong port, or the pool is down).
err.connect_failed: Could not reach the pool (network unreachable or connection reset).
err.connect_timeout: The pool did not answer the connection in time.
err.tls_certificate: The pool's TLS certificate is not trusted. Use TLS Off only if you know the pool has no TLS.
err.tls_pin_mismatch: The pool's key does not match the pinned key: the pool changed its certificate, or someone is in the middle. Not connecting.
err.tls_protocol: The pool does not speak TLS on this port. Try TLS Auto or Off.
err.tls_timeout: The TLS handshake took too long.
err.tls_config: The TLS settings are invalid (check the pinned key).
err.auth_rejected: The pool refused the login. Check your wallet address and worker name.
err.auth_timeout: The pool did not answer the login.
err.no_job: Logged in, but the pool sent no job.
err.line_too_long: The pool sent an oversized message.
err.protocol: The pool sent something that is not valid stratum/JSON.
err.reject_storm: Too many shares rejected as invalid on this pool.
err.stale_shares: Too many stale shares on this pool.
err.banned: The pool says this miner is banned; waiting before retrying.
err.stall: No new job for a long time, even after reconnecting.
err.update_required: The network was upgraded: this miner version cannot mine it. Update the miner.
err.wallet_invalid: Set a valid wallet and worker name first.
fee.title: Developer fee
fee.disclosure.1: This miner is free and open source. To fund its development it mines for the developer 2.00% of the time, only while it is mining for you:
fee.disclosure.2: It works as short time slices on a separate connection with the developer's own address and the worker name devfee, so your pool statistics stay yours. A slice is about 2 minutes for every 98 minutes of mining, never in the first 30 minutes after you start.
fee.disclosure.3: The fee wallet and rate are compiled into the program and cannot be changed by any setting, file or API. The Fee screen shows the measured percentage at any time.
fee.disclosure.4: If you mine to the developer's own address the fee switches itself off.
fee.accept: I read this and accept the 2.00% developer fee.
fee.readonly: Read-only: these values are compiled into the binary. Official releases are attested so you can check you run the published build.
fee.off: Your wallet is the fee wallet: the fee is off.
fee.suspend.v: more than {r}% of the last {n} fee shares rejected → off for {s} min
power.title: Power profile
power.intro: The DGX Spark can power off under sustained full GPU load. Balanced keeps a safe margin and is the recommended default.
power.eco.desc: lower power and heat than Balanced
power.max.desc: no power target; at your own risk
power.max.warn: Max can trigger the DGX Spark's hard power-off under sustained load. Unsaved work on this machine can be lost.
power.governor_note: The daemon's power governor enforces the profile: it steers the GPU to the target and pauses mining above the hard stop. A change applies at once.
power.clockcap.text: A boot-time cap of 2200 MHz makes power spikes much less likely. It needs sudo once; this command only prints the steps:
coex.title: Sharing the GPU
coex.detected: spark-modo was found on this machine: "spark-modo runtime" is recommended.
coex.spark-modo.desc: The worker runs only as the miner runtime of spark-modo (exclusive GPU lease); loading a model stops it.
coex.yield.desc: Pause while another program uses the GPU.
coex.yield-release.desc: Pause and free the GPU memory while another program uses the GPU.
coex.exclusive.desc: The GPU is dedicated to mining.
coex.note: Yield and yield-release watch the vLLM metrics (http://127.0.0.1:8001/metrics by default) and step aside while it has requests; the address and timings are in config.toml ([coexistence]).
sim.enable: CPU simulation instead of the GPU worker (testing only)
sim.note: The simulation uses the official reference miner on the CPU. It finds shares only on a test pool at trivial difficulty; on real pools it mines nothing.
gpu.title: GPU
gpu.name: GPU
fo.intro: When the active pool fails the miner moves to the next pool; when a better pool is healthy again it returns after the probe and stability times. The defaults suit almost everyone.
fo.stall_soft_reconnect_s.hint: Reconnect once, then fail over. Default {d}.
fo.max_consecutive_invalid.hint: Counts as a reject storm. Default {d}.
fo.reject_ratio_max.hint: Share of rejects (0–1) over the window. Default {d}.
fo.drain_s.hint: In-flight shares are still sent. Default {d}.
fo.reconnect_same_after_s: Reconnect to the same pool if it ran for (s)
fo.backoff_s.hint: Waits after consecutive failures; the last one repeats. Default 5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 120.
save.ok_restart: Saved. The API settings take effect after restarting the miner.
summary.title: Summary
logs.export_hint: The export contains the logs, status, pools and settings with wallet addresses redacted. Review it before sharing.
